registration.statement: For the complete registered gas-phase H2/D2 X-state boundary, the common Fold electronic base is seven-fifths of the held atomic-length carrier. The binary-order alpha return adds twenty-one alpha squared for H2 and twenty-four alpha squared for D2. Thus r_e(H2)/a0=7/5+21 alpha^2 and r_e(D2)/a0=7/5+24 alpha^2 before either NIST distance target is released.
